create_linear_projection: create a Linear projection module with specified input and output dimensions and optional bias
create_column_sharded_linear: create a ColumnShardedLinear projection sharded across its output dimension for tensor parallelism
create_row_sharded_linear: create a RowShardedLinear projection sharded across its input dimension for tensor parallelism
convert_sharded_to_linear: convert a ColumnShardedLinear or RowShardedLinear back to a standard Linear module using to_linear
init_bert_projection: initialize a Linear projection with BERT-style normal weight initialization and zero bias
